text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose...! The one who wins... is 
ME!!!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's sheer tenacity... Its sheer 
ferocity pulled victory right into her 
grasp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Her first crown on the road to the top!! 
This year's Oka Sho Umamusume is... 
Verxinaaaaaaa!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! Verxina is so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Congra~~ts!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you were so, so amazing! You 
really won!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool~! As expected of my big 
sis♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis really is... Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That's right. I am stronger than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved a brilliant victory, 
Verxina's face was brimming with pride and 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I believe this proves it, does it not? 
That the greatest of this generation—is 
me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, none other than...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Verxina as she savored her joy, I 
could feel something far beyond a mere 
victory. The reason was—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! ...Gentildonna-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations to you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Um, thank y—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, never let your guard down, by any 
means.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The next honor will certainly be— 
reclaimed by these legs of mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Verxina. I thought she 
would talk back, but... with a stern look, 
she simply saw her off. The reason being—”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The next Oaks is 2,400 meters. With the 
longer distance, there's no telling what 
might happen.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Throughout the race, I could 
constantly feel her sheer intensity."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"She isn't someone who will end with just 
this. In other words—winning today doesn't 
guarantee a victory tomorrow..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"However, the Oaks is the race that *I* 
rightfully ought to win."
choice_data_list:
It's what you've been aiming for all this 
time, after all.

It's what you've been aiming for all this 
time, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Oaks from the very 
beginning, she has trained up to this 
point keeping the Tokyo Racecourse track 
and the longer distance firmly in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's threat hasn't vanished, 
but... If it's Verxina, she can do it...!
choice_data_list:
Win the Oaks too, and that's the Double 
Crown!

Win the Oaks too, and you'll have the 
Double Crown!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, my younger sisters... will 
finally understand my greatness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis / Big brother, congrats~~♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Eek!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina is tightly tackled by Vivlos as 
she suddenly comes flying in. Carried by 
the momentum, they tumble onto the waiting 
room sofa.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, that was suuuuper cool! 
Congratulations, seriously!♡♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Sister.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The next Oaks too... I'm sure Big Sis can 
do it...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I'll win. —Be sure to watch 
me closely, okay?
